other_conditions: Engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Not a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
No membership of Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or a family member of the worker
Must have exhausted the benefit of ₹50,000 under the Bhagat “Puran Singh Sehat Beema Yojna” scheme
benefits_summary: Up to ₹1,50,000 reimbursement for silicosis treatment after exhausting the prior ₹50,000 benefit under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Beema Yojna scheme.
